title: High ticket work, and no predictable way to find it.

items.value: High ticket work, and no predictable way to find it.

Interior design is a considered purchase. A client thinks about it for weeks, talks to a partner, compares three studios, and only then picks up the phone. Referrals bring some of that work, but referrals arrive when they arrive.
A studio of two people cannot chase every inquiry, so the ones worth having have to be identified early. Volume alone is useless here. One good lead is worth fifty browsers.
And a studio with no social presence has nothing for a prospective client to look at between the first conversation and the decision.

title: Interior design marketing built for a long decision

Interior design is not an impulse buy, so the campaigns are built to start a conversation rather than close a sale in one click.
The ad, the landing step and the follow up designed as one path, so a serious inquiry reaches the studio with context attached.
Their finished interiors are the strongest asset they have, so the campaigns run on real work rather than stock.

title: Our longest running client, and the clearest proof we have

items.value: Our longest running client, and the clearest proof we have

SVJ ArchInterió has been with Digitorium for more than five years, and the business has grown every year of it. More than ₹5 lakh of annual ad spend now returns ₹4 to 5 crore of business across a full year, and the studio has gone from two people in an office to more than ten.
The organic side started in May 2026 and reached 1,200 plus followers from 400 by June. Those inquiries arrive already warm, and the studio is closing them within two or three days.
Do Meta ads work for interior designers?
They do, but not as a one click sale. Interior design is a considered purchase, so the campaign has to open a conversation and the follow up has to be quick. Ads alone will not do it.
How much should an interior design studio spend on ads?
It depends on your ticket size and how fast you follow up. SVJ spends more than five lakh a year, but they built to that over five years rather than starting there.
Does organic social actually bring inquiries?
For this studio it did within two months. It works because a client comparing three studios wants something to look at while they decide, and a live feed of finished projects is exactly that.
5,000 plus qualified leads and 1,000 plus regular clients for a channel partner that started with nothing.
